repair.rule: Execution follows a complete persisted assessment bound to the compiled source contract and statement identities. Existing-failure judgments select defect across all executable roles; missing or unresolved judgments hold before baseline or later legacy effects. The host independently compares the primitive claim with the judgments and still requires defect reproduction. No English parser or default-new fallback remains.
repair.controls: Explicit source/role/producer controls are fixture annotations, not a model accuracy evaluation. Both entries reproduce the reported failures in both supplied roles. Real primitive witnesses with deliberately conflicting new claims stop with the required finding, zero source launches and no remote effects. Missing/incomplete/unresolved/stale inputs, saved legacy runs before source and publication, semantic recovery without source rewording, and a requirement describing a bug completing the defect loop pass. Eleven healthy controls complete all fourteen steps.
